summary: C-0003: The field itself reports NO consensus on hypnosis mechanisms; the ALE meta-analysis failed to confirm predicted DMN/SN/CEN involvement — the brain-correlate story is heterogeneous and contested
content: CLAIM C-0003: A 2024 systematic review (Zahedi et al.) states explicitly that 'no consensus exists regarding the mechanisms' driving hypnotic responses, and that each theory has distinct strengths/limits. The Landry et al. ALE meta-analysis (cited in the 2024 MRS paper) did NOT confirm the hypothesized DMN/SN/CEN involvement and instead found only a medial lingual gyrus link, attributed partly to methodological heterogeneity. The 2025 Brain Sci. review notes neural mechanisms are 'not fully understood'. This is the field's own self-reported unsettled status. SUPPORTS: the question is genuinely contested at the empirical level, not just philosophically.
